beforeImage.name: QSP
beforeImage.description: QSP is a joint venture that owns three fully constructed hyperscale data centers in Northern Virginia. Its customer base consists of investment-grade hyperscale and enterprise tenants requiring large-scale colocation and critical IT capacity in the largest U.S. data center market. The operating model is asset heavy and contracted, with the portfolio fully leased and operated by QTS rather than dependent on speculative lease-up. Public materials state that the portfolio provides approximately 100 megawatts of critical IT capacity across the three facilities. Wren House completed its investment in the joint venture in 2024 as part of a recapitalization in which QTS retained an ownership stake and operating role. Current public materials also note the presence of another investor in the joint venture, but that investor's identity and ownership split are not fully disclosed on the cited sources.

afterImage.name: QSP
afterImage.description: QSP is a joint venture that owns three fully constructed and fully leased hyperscale data centers in Northern Virginia. The portfolio provides approximately 100 MW of critical IT capacity and is operated by QTS. Wren House and BlackRock completed their majority investment in November 2024, while QTS retained a minority ownership interest and the operating role under upstream owner Blackstone. Exact direct ownership percentages, the joint venture's full legal name and the legal investing vehicles are not publicly disclosed.
